chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, was asked about the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, turning his cloak when he sought rain. He said:
"It was a sign between him and his companions that drought had turned into abundance."

key_terms.اسْتَسْقَى: he sought rain through prayer and supplication
key_terms.الْجَدْبُ: drought, barrenness, or lack of rain
key_terms.تَحْوِيلِ: turning or reversing, here referring to the turning of the cloak

ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله turn his cloak during the prayer for rain?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the meaning of the Prophet’s, peace be upon him and his family, turning of his cloak during the salat for rain. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that it served as a sign to indicate the hoped-for change from drought to fertility and abundance.
